title: LangChain and LlamaIndex in multimodal applications

videos.script: The last four lessons called the providers directly. The SDK, a request, a reply. {{title}} Many applications are not written that way. They are written with LangChain or LlamaIndex, and the picture or the recording goes through the framework first. {{frameworks}} So this lesson sends the same book cover through both of them, and looks at the request each one built. {{same}} Then two pieces of real work. A recorded call turned into a support ticket, in one chain. And one search index over an invoice, a call and a voicemail. {{work}} The frameworks are real, at pinned versions. The transcripts and the search are real. The replies to images and the ticket were written by the course, and the log says so every time. {{end}}
